default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-868.title: Return-volume correlation follow
E-868.hypothesis: When bar returns and volumes correlate strongly positively over a window, volume arrives with the move (informed, aggressive flow); follow the net direction at the first crossing.

E-869.title: Stale-close share break
E-869.hypothesis: A window with many unchanged closes means quoting is stale and the book is left alone; the first close beyond the window's range shows who finally acts; follow.

E-870.title: Range-share thrust at a session extreme
E-870.hypothesis: When the last window covers most of the whole session range so far and sets a session extreme, one side has taken the day in one thrust with no balance; follow.

E-871.title: Wick-chop regime stretch fade
E-871.hypothesis: Bar ranges much larger than the net bar-to-bar steps mean two-sided wicks: a mean-reverting regime where liquidity providers win; fade a 1.5 sigma stretch inside it.

E-872.title: Hour-open recross follow
E-872.hypothesis: The price at the start of each clock hour is a reference for hourly algos and desks; after a spell on one side, a close back across it moves the average hourly participant to the other side; follow.

E-873.title: Semi-variance dominance follow
E-873.hypothesis: When the squared up-moves dominate the squared down-moves in a window, the volatility is upside-driven (buyers pay up); follow the first crossing of the dominance threshold.

E-874.title: Volume point-of-control magnet fade
E-874.hypothesis: The price bin with most volume today is the accepted value; price stretched far from it by impatient flow is pulled back as the auction rebalances; fade the stretch.

E-875.title: Triple-touch ceiling/floor break
E-875.hypothesis: Three or more highs (lows) stopping at the same level inside a window show resting limit orders there; a close through it consumes them and releases stops; follow.

E-876.title: Three soldiers/crows reversal from the wrong side of the EMA
E-876.hypothesis: Three strong, nested same-colour bodies that start from the far side of the EMA show a forced change of control after an exhausted move; trade the new direction.

E-877.title: Tenkan/Kijun cross with price agreement
E-877.hypothesis: Midpoint of the short high/low channel crossing the midpoint of a 3x longer channel while price stays on that side shows short-horizon traders overtaking the slow ones (Ichimoku base lines); follow.
